Third-party browser libraries, committed so the app starts without internet
access and doesn't change behaviour when a CDN's "latest" moves on.

react.production.min.js       React 18.3.1      https://unpkg.com/react@18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js          (MIT)
react-dom.production.min.js   ReactDOM 18.3.1   https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18.3.1/umd/react-dom.production.min.js  (MIT)
babel.min.js                  @babel/standalone 8.0.6  https://unpkg.com/@babel/standalone@8.0.6/babel.min.js        (MIT)

To upgrade, download the new pinned file over the old one, update this list,
and run through every screen of the app before committing.
